## R Markdown

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r cars}

library(DiagrammeR)

grViz("
digraph conceptual_model {

  graph [
    layout = dot,
    rankdir = TB,
    bgcolor = 'white',
    pad = 0.35,
    nodesep = 0.45,
    ranksep = 0.55,
    splines = ortho
  ]

  node [
    shape = box,
    style = 'rounded,filled',
    fontname = Helvetica,
    fontsize = 18,
    color = '#8A8A8A',
    penwidth = 1.2,
    margin = 0.20
  ]

  edge [
    color = '#8A8A8A',
    arrowsize = 0.8,
    penwidth = 1.8
  ]

  # Main pathway nodes
  PI [label = 'Peripheral Inflammation\\n(Eotaxin-1, MCP-1, TNF-α, IL-6)',
      fillcolor = '#E8C3A0']

  NI [label = 'Neuroinflammation in the Brain',
      fillcolor = '#EED2B7']

  AP [label = 'Amyloid Pathology (Aβ)',
      fillcolor = '#EED2B7']

  BS [label = 'Brain Structural Changes\\n(Hippocampal atrophy, cortical thinning)',
      fillcolor = '#D8DEE8']

  CD [label = 'Cognitive Decline\\n(Memory impairment)',
      fillcolor = '#E6DDEC']

  CP [label = 'Clinical Progression of aMCI',
      fillcolor = '#E7D6D6']

  AD [label = 'Alzheimer\\'s Disease',
      fillcolor = '#C37C73',
      fontcolor = 'white',
      color = '#B06C64']

  # Aim boxes
  AIM1 [label = 'Aim 1\\nEvaluate longitudinal associations\\nbetween peripheral inflammatory\\nmarkers and:\\n• Cognitive decline\\n• Brain structural changes',
        fillcolor = '#F5EFD8',
        fontsize = 15,
        penwidth = 1.0]

  AIM2 [label = 'Aim 2\\nPeripheral inflammation moderates\\nthe relationship between\\namyloid pathology and clinical\\nprogression of aMCI',
        fillcolor = '#E3EAF5',
        fontsize = 15,
        penwidth = 1.0]

  # Main biological pathway
  PI -> NI [color = '#C6864F']
  NI -> AP [color = '#C6864F']
  AP -> BS [color = '#8DA9D6']
  BS -> CD [color = '#9A8DC2']
  CD -> CP [color = '#C7A0B8']
  CP -> AD [color = '#C96B5F']

  # Aim 1: association targets
  AIM1 -> BS [style = dashed, color = '#C6864F', penwidth = 1.6]
  AIM1 -> CD [style = dashed, color = '#C6864F', penwidth = 1.6]

  # Aim 2: moderation cue on pathology -> progression
  AIM2 -> AP [style = dashed, color = '#7D95C9', penwidth = 1.6]
  AIM2 -> CP [style = dashed, color = '#7D95C9', penwidth = 1.6]

  # Layout helpers
  { rank = same; AIM1; AP; AIM2 }

  # Invisible edges for stable placement
  AIM1 -> AP [style = invis]
  AP -> AIM2 [style = invis]
}
")

```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
library(DiagrammeR)

grViz("
digraph conceptual_model {

  graph [
    layout = dot,
    rankdir = TB,
    bgcolor = 'white',
    pad = 0.35,
    nodesep = 0.45,
    ranksep = 0.55,
    splines = ortho
  ]

  node [
    shape = box,
    style = 'rounded,filled',
    fontname = Helvetica,
    fontsize = 18,
    color = '#9A9A9A',
    penwidth = 1.2,
    margin = 0.20
  ]

  edge [
    color = '#8A8A8A',
    arrowsize = 0.8,
    penwidth = 1.8
  ]

  # =========================
  # Main pathway nodes
  # =========================
  PI [label = 'Peripheral Inflammation\\n(Eotaxin-1, MCP-1, TNF-α, IL-6)',
      fillcolor = '#E8C9A8']

  NI [label = 'Neuroinflammation in the Brain',
      fillcolor = '#EED8C2']

  AP [label = 'Amyloid Pathology (Aβ)',
      fillcolor = '#EED8C2']

  BS [label = 'Brain Structural Changes\\n(Hippocampal atrophy, cortical thinning)',
      fillcolor = '#DCE3EE']

  CD [label = 'Cognitive Decline\\n(Memory impairment)',
      fillcolor = '#E7E0EC']

  CP [label = 'Clinical Progression of aMCI',
      fillcolor = '#E6DDDD']

  AD [label = 'Alzheimer\\'s Disease',
      fillcolor = '#C4867D',
      fontcolor = 'white',
      color = '#B8756B']

  # =========================
  # Aim boxes
  # =========================
  AIM1 [label = 'Aim 1\\nEvaluate longitudinal associations\\nbetween peripheral inflammatory\\nmarkers and:\\n• Cognitive decline\\n• Brain structural changes',
        fillcolor = '#F6F0D8',
        fontsize = 15,
        penwidth = 1.0]

  AIM2 [label = 'Aim 2\\nPeripheral inflammation moderates\\nthe relationship between\\namyloid pathology and clinical\\nprogression of aMCI',
        fillcolor = '#E5EBF5',
        fontsize = 15,
        penwidth = 1.0]

  MOD [label = 'Moderation\\n(Aim 2)',
       shape = plaintext,
       fontsize = 14,
       fontcolor = '#6E85B7']

  # =========================
  # Legend
  # =========================
  LEGEND [label = 'Legend\\l────►  Hypothesized biological pathway\\l- - - ►  Relationships tested in study aims\\l',
          shape = box,
          style = 'rounded,filled',
          fillcolor = '#F7F7F7',
          fontsize = 14,
          margin = 0.18]

  # Dummy nodes for legend arrows
  L1A [label = '', shape = point, width = 0.01]
  L1B [label = '', shape = point, width = 0.01]
  L2A [label = '', shape = point, width = 0.01]
  L2B [label = '', shape = point, width = 0.01]

  # =========================
  # Main biological pathway
  # =========================
  PI -> NI [color = '#C78958', penwidth = 2.0]
  NI -> AP [color = '#C78958', penwidth = 2.0]
  AP -> BS [color = '#9AB0D8', penwidth = 2.0]
  BS -> CD [color = '#AE9DCD', penwidth = 2.0]
  CD -> CP [color = '#C3A2B7', penwidth = 2.0]
  CP -> AD [color = '#C96F63', penwidth = 2.0]

  # =========================
  # Aim 1 relationships
  # =========================
  AIM1 -> BS [style = dashed, color = '#C78958', penwidth = 1.6]
  AIM1 -> CD [style = dashed, color = '#C78958', penwidth = 1.6]

  # =========================
  # Aim 2 moderation display
  # =========================
  AIM2 -> AP [style = dashed, color = '#8EA6D6', penwidth = 1.6]
  AIM2 -> CP [style = dashed, color = '#8EA6D6', penwidth = 1.6]

  # Optional direct conceptual relation for moderation target
  AP -> CP [style = dashed, color = '#B8C4E3', penwidth = 1.3, constraint = false]

  MOD -> AP [style = invis]
  MOD -> CP [style = invis]

  # =========================
  # Legend arrows
  # =========================
  L1A -> L1B [color = '#7F7F7F', penwidth = 2.0]
  L2A -> L2B [style = dashed, color = '#7F7F7F', penwidth = 1.6]

  # =========================
  # Layout
  # =========================
  { rank = same; AIM1; AP; AIM2 }
  { rank = same; LEGEND; L1A; L1B; L2A; L2B }

  # Invisible edges to stabilize layout
  AIM1 -> AP [style = invis]
  AP -> AIM2 [style = invis]
  AD -> LEGEND [style = invis]
  LEGEND -> L1A [style = invis]
  L1B -> L2A [style = invis]
}
")
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.





```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
library(DiagrammeR)
library(DiagrammeRsvg)
library(rsvg)

theoretical <- grViz("
digraph conceptual_model {

  graph [
    layout = dot,
    rankdir = TB,
    bgcolor = 'white',
    pad = 0.4,
    nodesep = 0.45,
    ranksep = 0.70,
    splines = ortho
  ]

  node [
    shape = box,
    style = 'rounded,filled',
    fontname = Helvetica,
    fontsize = 18,
    color = '#9A9A9A',
    penwidth = 1.1,
    margin = 0.20
  ]

  edge [
    arrowsize = 0.8,
    penwidth = 1.8,
    color = '#8A8A8A'
  ]

  # -------------------------
  # Title
  # -------------------------
  TITLE [label = 'Conceptual Framework: Peripheral Inflammation, Amyloid Pathology, and Cognitive Decline in aMCI',
         shape = plaintext,
         fontsize = 22,
         fontcolor = '#3A3A3A']

  # -------------------------
  # Main pathway nodes
  # -------------------------
  PI [label = 'Peripheral Inflammation\\n(IL-6, TNF-α, MCP-1, Eotaxin-1)',
      fillcolor = '#E6C9A8']

  NI [label = 'Neuroinflammation in the Brain',
      fillcolor = '#EBD8C3']

  AP [label = 'Amyloid Pathology (Aβ)',
      fillcolor = '#EBD8C3']

  BS [label = 'Brain Structural Changes\\n(Change in AD-signature cortical thickness)',
      fillcolor = '#DCE3EE']

  CD [label = 'Episodic Memory Decline\\n(Change in episodic memory)',
      fillcolor = '#E7E0EC']

  CP [label = 'Clinical Progression of aMCI',
      fillcolor = '#E6DDDD']

  AD [label = 'Alzheimer\\'s Disease',
      fillcolor = '#C58B83',
      fontcolor = 'white',
      color = '#B87A72']

  # -------------------------
  # Aim boxes
  # -------------------------
  AIM1 [label = 'Aim 1\\nTest whether peripheral inflammatory\\nmarkers predict longitudinal change in:\\n• Episodic memory\\n• AD-signature cortical thickness',
        fillcolor = '#F5F0DD',
        fontsize = 15,
        penwidth = 1.0]

  AIM2 [label = 'Aim 2\\nTest whether peripheral inflammation\\nmoderates the relationship between\\namyloid pathology and longitudinal change in:\\n• Episodic memory\\n• AD-signature cortical thickness',
        fillcolor = '#E7ECF5',
        fontsize = 15,
        penwidth = 1.0]

  COV [label = 'Covariates\\nAge, sex, education, diagnostic group,\\nAPOE genotype, BMI, hypercholesterolemia,\\nNSAID use, immune-related health conditions',
       fillcolor = '#F7F7F7',
       fontsize = 13,
       penwidth = 1.0]

  # -------------------------
  # Legend box
  # -------------------------
  LEG [label = 'Legend\\lSolid arrows: hypothesized biological pathways\\lOrange dashed arrows: associations tested in Aim 1\\lBlue dashed arrows: moderation tested in Aim 2\\l',
       shape = box,
       style = 'rounded,filled',
       fillcolor = '#F7F7F7',
       fontsize = 13,
       margin = 0.16]

  # -------------------------
  # Main biological pathway
  # -------------------------
  PI -> NI [color = '#C78C58', penwidth = 2.0]
  NI -> AP [color = '#C78C58', penwidth = 2.0]
  AP -> BS [color = '#9EB2DA', penwidth = 2.0]
  BS -> CD [color = '#AA9ECC', penwidth = 2.0]
  CD -> CP [color = '#C2A7BA', penwidth = 2.0]
  CP -> AD [color = '#C86D61', penwidth = 2.0]

  # -------------------------
  # Aim 1 links
  # -------------------------
  AIM1 -> BS [style = dashed, color = '#C78C58', penwidth = 1.6]
  AIM1 -> CD [style = dashed, color = '#C78C58', penwidth = 1.6]

  # -------------------------
  # Aim 2 moderation links
  # -------------------------
  AIM2 -> AP [style = dashed, color = '#8EA6D6', penwidth = 1.6]
  AIM2 -> BS [style = dashed, color = '#8EA6D6', penwidth = 1.6]
  AIM2 -> CD [style = dashed, color = '#8EA6D6', penwidth = 1.6]

  # -------------------------
  # Layout helpers
  # -------------------------
  { rank = same; AIM1; AP; AIM2 }
  { rank = same; LEG; COV }

  TITLE -> PI [style = invis]
  AIM1 -> AP [style = invis]
  AP -> AIM2 [style = invis]
  CP -> LEG [style = invis]
}
")
```




```{r}
svg_txt <- export_svg(theoretical)  # returns SVG text
rsvg_png(charToRaw(svg_txt),
         file = "Figure_theoreticalfinal.png",
         width = 3000, height = 4000)  # high-res
```
